bio: Hello! My name is Jeffrey Prince (he/him), and I graduated from Harvard College in 2022 with a concentration in Molecular and Cellular Biology and a secondary in Educational Studies. After graduating, I spent two years teaching high school biology in East Boston, and I am currently a medical student at HMS in the class of 2028. While at the College, I was involved with WHRB, the PAF program, and Adams HoCo. I grew up near Boston with five siblings and have moved around different parts of the area for the last several years. Outside of medicine and advising, I enjoy spending time with my family and friends, playing video games, and cheering on Boston’s sports teams. I am so excited to meet you!
